items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: Yes, I saw Ralph. I didn't see his brother, the other Capone, but Ralph Capone I saw many times.

ctx.x: Did you ever see him or meet him?
Yes, I saw Ralph. I didn't see his brother, the other Capone, but Ralph Capone I saw many times.
Then you got so lonely for New York you had to go back?
